info.title: ai-pr-review-assistant API
info.description: Dashboard API. Authenticate with the session cookie set by /auth/github/login. Mutating requests also need the X-CSRF-Token header (the value is in the response of GET /api/me). Errors use a common envelope.

get.description: Redirects to GitHub. `return_to` must be a path on the dashboard.
Checks `state`, exchanges the code, creates the session and redirects to the dashboard.

get.summary: Current user, accessible installations and the App install link
Repositories the user can see, with their last run
Runs of the repositories the user can see, newest first
get.description: Filters: repo_id, status (one or a comma-separated list), branch (base branch), author, severity, from, to. Cursor pagination: pass next_cursor back as cursor.

get.summary: One run with its agent runs, findings, skipped files, warnings and usage

post.summary: Re-run a review for the pull request's current commit
post.description: Admin only, audited. Creates a new queued run linked to this one (`parent_run_id`) for the commit the pull request points at now, and supersedes any run of the pull request that is still active. Answers 409 when the pull request is closed or the repository or installation is no longer active.

403.description: Signed in and able to see the resource, but not an admin

post.summary: Cancel a queued or running review
post.description: Admin only, audited. Stops the run and closes its Check Run. Answers 409 when the run is not queued or running.

403.description: Signed in and able to see the resource, but not an admin

get.summary: Findings across runs of the repositories the user can see, newest first
get.description: Filters: repo_id, run_id, severity, category, agent, status (posted, summary_only, suppressed or all; default: what the review reported), path (part of the file path), from, to. Cursor pagination.

get.summary: One finding with its feedback and a link to the GitHub comment or line

post.summary: Say whether a finding was useful, a false positive or already known
post.description: Any user who can see the repository. One vote per user per finding: sending it again replaces the verdict and note. Findings the review dropped (suppressed) cannot be rated: 409.

get.summary: Every run of one pull request, with what changed in the findings between them
The PRD success metrics for the repositories the user can see
get.description: Filters: repo_id or installation_id, from, to (default: the last 30 days). Every rate comes with the number of observations it rests on.

get.summary: Reviews, findings, duration, failures and tokens over time
get.description: Same filters as the summary plus bucket (day or week). Buckets are UTC; a range longer than 92 days is answered in weeks whatever was asked.

get.summary: Settings, credential, re-run and cancel actions of the installation, newest first

403.description: Signed in and able to see the resource, but not an admin

get.summary: Download the repository's runs or findings as CSV
get.description: Admin only, audited. kind is runs or findings; from and to bound the time the run was queued. At most 20,000 rows. Cells that a spreadsheet could read as a formula are prefixed with an apostrophe.

403.description: Signed in and able to see the resource, but not an admin

get.summary: Server-sent events: run.updated for the repositories the user can see
get.description: A `text/event-stream`. `run.updated` events carry run_id, repo_id, status and at (see runUpdatedEventSchema); refetch the run through the normal endpoints. Comment lines are heartbeats. The stream ends when the session does.

get.summary: Repository settings and the effective configuration

patch.summary: Update repository settings, or enable or disable the repository
patch.description: Admin only. Unknown keys and invalid values are rejected; `base_url` must be a public HTTPS URL.

config.description: Partial configuration. Mappings merge, arrays and scalars replace, null removes a key.
